gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Bold and brash up top, then softer below. Comic Relief hands off to M PLUS Rounded 1c, whose gentle sans-serif strokes stop short of curling back, so paragraphs of it feel approachable and easy going.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-manjari: Chunky, loose-limbed headlines from Comic Relief sit over Manjari, a sans-serif whose curves end in wide, unclosed terminals. The gap between them is the draw.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-meera-inimai: Commanding is how Comic Relief lands, its bowls left unfinished on one side and every stroke drawn the same all round. And Meera Inimai, a plain sans with open-ended curves, gives that loudness somewhere quiet to rest.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-metrophobic: Rope-like lines, loud and bendy, set the tone in Comic Relief, with every stem, bowl and tail looking twisted from one strand. Metrophobic follows in a smooth sans-serif, letting each bend run clear, so the heading gets the attention and the text stays out of its way.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-mina: Mina is a sans with strokes as plain as stitched thread outlines, and its small round letters hang generously open beneath Comic Relief. That gap is what makes it work.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-mingzat: Mingzat brings curvy, unclamped letters in a plain sans, set under Comic Relief's wire-thick strokes. Mingzat keeps a long page of text loose and contemporary, never fighting the heading above.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-moderustic: Contemporary in feel, Moderustic traces its curves with a broad nib and leaves them unfinished, a sans that sits below Comic Relief's tube-smooth headings. Both leave their shapes open.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-molengo: Comic Relief lays its letters out like spaghetti, every line bold and unbroken, so it needs room to stand tall. But Molengo, a plain sans with wide gaps, keeps tiny sizes crisp, while a shrunken heading would lose its swagger.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-momo-trust-sans: Comic Relief goes loud, with unfinished bowls and strokes that never change. Momo Trust Sans meets it with bowls as heavy as its stems and wide, unclosed mouths, a friendly sans that holds its own.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-mona-sans: Curves and stems moving in lockstep give Comic Relief its stubborn, bold presence. Mona Sans counters with letter openings as wide as a door left ajar, and that clear difference in attitude is the pair's strongest quality.
